title: Orphan Games: Game Boy in the FPGA
summary: The original Game Boy rebuilt in the FPGA (VerilogBoy by Wenting Zhang, OHDL 1.0): its CPU, picture chip and sound in hardware, with Orphan's own boot ROM. Play free homebrew Game Boy games from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Carts up to 128 KB, no mapper / MBC1 / MBC3 / MBC5. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: Game Boy (cart, frame buffer, sound, pads)
